mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) below a 12-month moving average signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST drops do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO declines do not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above the 12-month average signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increases do not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) above the 12-month moving average signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases do not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, the combination signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of rising INDPRO and falling UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent market strength.
